verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: See, I have called him by the name of Zelael, son of Uri, son of Hur. He was appointed as the leader of Judah.
verses.3: And He filled him with the spirit of God, with wisdom, understanding, and all kinds of knowledge.
verses.4: It’s about thinking in terms of things that can be done with gold, silver, and other precious metals.
verses.5: And in the spring, wood is used for construction; and in the spring, trees are cut down for various purposes.
verses.6: And I have given him Ahithophel, son of Achisamaq, as a leader over Dan. In the hearts of all wise men, I have placed wisdom, and they have done everything you commanded them to do.
verses.7: And the tent of meetings, and the altar for offerings, and the ark upon which it stands, and all the utensils of the tent.
verses.8: And the altar, and all its utensils, and the purest lampstand, and all its utensils. And also the altar of the incense.
verses.9: And the altar, and all its utensils, and the incense burner, and the candlestick.
verses.10: And the garments of the priests, and the garments of Aaron, the priest, and the garments of his sons, for the priests.
verses.11: And the wine for the sacrifices, and all the utensils used for the sacred offerings, must be done according to your commands.
verses.12: And the LORD said to Moses, “Say…”
verses.13: And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, “You shall keep my laws. This is a covenant between me and you forever. So that you may know that I, the LORD, have sanctified you.”
verses.14: And you shall keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you. Do not profane it with death or any other sin. All work done on that day is considered unholy, and the soul that does such work is marked as unclean by God.
verses.15: For six days, work must be done. But on the seventh day, it is a Sabbath, holy to Jehovah. All work must be stopped on the Sabbath day.
verses.16: And the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, so that they may observe it as an everlasting covenant for them.
verses.17: Between me and the children of Israel, this will be a forever bond. For six days, Jehovah created the heavens and the earth. On the seventh day, He rested.
verses.18: And He gave Moses a stick, so that he could speak to Him on Mount Sinai. Those two sticks were made of wood, with words written on them by God.
